content.short: Pell Network is an omnichain Bitcoin restaking network for BTC-backed shared cryptoeconomic security.
content.description: Pell Network is a BTC restaking network that extends Bitcoin and BTC liquid staking derivative security into decentralized validation services. The protocol lets stakers restake BTC-related assets, delegate security, and earn rewards while developers can bootstrap applications with a shared trust network instead of building a validator set from scratch. Pell's architecture includes restaking contracts across chains, a restaking ledger, cross-chain messaging, and Pell Chain for unified service management. On Mantle, Pell Network supports BTCFi restaking and shared security opportunities for users and builders.
content.meta: Pell Network provides omnichain BTC restaking and shared security infrastructure for Mantle.
